questions.questionText: Agrippa said to Paul, You have permission to speak for yourself. Then Paul motioned with his hand and began his defense. He said he was fortunate to stand before Agrippa because Agrippa was well acquainted with what?
options: All the Jewish customs and controversies

questions.questionText: Paul said the Jewish people all know the way he has lived since childhood, first in his own country and then in Jerusalem. He lived as a what?

Paul said he was on trial because of his hope in what God has promised our ancestors. The twelve tribes earnestly serve God day and night hoping to see that promise. Why should any of you consider it incredible that God raises the dead? Paul said he was convinced he ought to do all that was possible to oppose whose name?

On the authority of the chief priests Paul put many saints in prison. When they were put to death, he cast his vote against them. He tried to force them to blaspheme and in raging fury he persecuted them even to foreign cities. On one of these journeys he was going to Damascus with what?
options: The authority and commission of the chief priests

questions.questionText: About noon, King Agrippa, I saw a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, blazing around me and my companions. We all fell to the ground. Then Paul heard a voice in what language?
The voice said, It is hard for you to kick against the goads. Paul asked who are you, Lord? The answer?
options: I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting

questions.questionText: Jesus said he appeared to appoint Paul as servant and witness. He was sending Paul to Jews and Gentiles to open their eyes and turn them from darkness to light, from the power of Satan to God, so that they may receive forgiveness of sins. Paul was not disobedient to the vision. He preached they should repent and turn to God and demonstrate their repentance by their deeds. For this the Jews seized him in the temple. But God has helped him to this day. He said nothing beyond what the prophets and Moses said would happen—that the Messiah would suffer and rise and bring the message of light. Festus interrupted and said what?
options: You are out of your mind, Paul! Your great learning is driving you insane

questions.questionText: Paul said, I am not insane, most excellent Festus. What I am saying is true and reasonable. Then he asked Agrippa if he believed the prophets. Agrippa said what?
options: Do you think that in such a short time you can persuade me to be a Christian?
I believe and will be baptized now

questions.questionText: Paul replied, Short time or long—I pray to God that not only you but all who are listening to me today may become what I am, except for these chains. The king rose, and with him the governor and Bernice and those sitting with them. They said this man is not doing anything that deserves death or imprisonment. Agrippa said to Festus he could have been set free if he had not what?
I said Paul was out of his mind because of great learning. Who am I?
I asked if Paul thought he could persuade me to be a Christian so soon. Who am I?
Jesus said, It is hard for you to kick against the _____.
True or false: Paul said he voted against Christians when they were put to death.
Paul said he tried to force them to do what?
The light brighter than the sun appeared on the road to where?
Get up and stand on your feet. I have appeared to you to appoint you as a servant and as a witness. Who said this?
options: Ananias in this speech version of the call

questions.questionText: Paul was sent to open eyes and turn people from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God so they may receive what?
options: Forgiveness of sins and a place among those who are sanctified by faith in Jesus

questions.questionText: True or false: Paul was not disobedient to the vision from heaven.
First to those in Damascus, then to those in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and then to the Gentiles, Paul preached they should what?
options: Repent and turn to God and demonstrate their repentance by their deeds

questions.questionText: That is why some Jews seized Paul in the temple courts and tried to kill him. But God has helped him to this day. He stands and testifies to small and great alike. He said nothing beyond Moses and the prophets—that the Messiah would suffer and, as the first to rise from the dead, would bring the message of light to his own people and to the Gentiles. Who interrupted loudly?

Paul said What I am saying is true and reasonable. The king is familiar with these things. It was not done in a corner. King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know you do. What did Agrippa call the new identity?
Paul prayed that all listening would become what he is, except for what?
Who rose first after the speech?
options: The king, then the governor and Bernice and those sitting with them

questions.questionText: True or false: They said Paul was not doing anything that deserves death or imprisonment.
options: False — they said he must die
True — so they ignored the appeal

questions.questionText: Who said Paul could have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar?
I lived as a Pharisee according to the strictest sect of our religion. Who am I?
Paul said he is on trial because of the hope of what?
options: What God has promised our ancestors

questions.questionText: True or false: The twelve tribes hope to see that promise as they serve God day and night.
options: True — but Paul denied the promise

questions.questionText: Who gave Paul authority to lock up many saints in prisons?
Why should any of you consider it incredible that God raises the _____?
Jesus told Paul he would be rescued from his own people and from the Gentiles. To whom was he being sent?
options: The Gentiles as well, to open their eyes
Only to Caesar as a soldier

questions.questionText: True or false: Paul said these things were not done in a corner.
options: True — Festus agreed he was sane

questions.questionText: I am most excellent and Paul said he is not insane. Who am I?
Jews seized Paul in which courts and tried to kill him?
The Messiah would suffer and rise from the dead and bring the message of light to whom?
options: His own people and to the Gentiles

questions.questionText: True or false: Agrippa, Festus and Bernice talked together after they left the room.
options: True — they condemned Paul to death

questions.questionText: Who motioned with his hand and began his defense?
Paul’s early life was in his own country and then in where?
Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads. Spoken in which language?
True or false: Paul preached first in Damascus after the vision.
options: True — but only to kings first
